Over 72h, two-way consolidation is more defensible than uninterrupted decline or recovery. At 168h, there is no dependable directional edge. Positive stablecoin supply growth and historical 30d/90d returns oppose extrapolating current weakness, but neither establishes deployed demand or altcoin transmission. The structural prior is context only; overlapping Top-100 breadth views are one evidence family, not independent confirmations. These are descriptive, non-binding forecasts with no execution authority or framework changes.
